parameters.content:
## 📖 How This Works — Read Me First

This workflow has 4 independent branches, all living in one file:

**A. Real-Time Sale Processing** (webhook)
A sale comes in → validated → checked for duplicates → checked against real stock → inventory updated → sale logged → low-stock alert if needed → caller gets a real answer back (not just "received").

**B. Daily Low-Stock Digest** (8 AM every day)
One consolidated Telegram + email message listing everything that needs reordering, instead of getting spammed one alert per sale.

**C. Weekly Sales Analytics Report** (Monday 9 AM)
Top-selling products, total units, and total revenue for the last 7 days.

**D. Global Error Alerts**
If ANY node in this workflow fails, you get pinged on Telegram immediately.

Set up your Google Sheet (see the note below) before running anything.

## Branch E — Product Availability (read-only)
Lets the demo storefront show In Stock / Low Stock / Out of Stock per product, without exposing exact counts.
